summary: All three spec-review blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json before spec-gate.

items.title: Bulk candidate planning lacks a non-mutating integration point
items.rationale: The spec currently references retained bulk update behavior but does not require a non-mutating plan phase. That would let implementation use the existing mutating syncInstalledPlugins update path before confirmation.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow[0] says candidate check resolves and computes candidates, but requirements and tasks do not name a non-mutating registry helper or plan/apply split.

items.title: Scope conflicts with existing disabled-package behavior
items.rationale: The spec says all installed plugins while also preserving update-all behavior. Existing bulk update excludes disabled packages, so the spec must state disabled packages remain excluded.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in and R1/R2/R5 use all installed plugin wording; source context for syncInstalledPlugins filters packages where enabled !== false.

items.title: JSON-mode confirmation stream is unspecified
items.rationale: The spec preserves JSON output semantics but does not define prompt stream behavior. Without this, --json stdout can become invalid when prompting.
items.evidence: spec.json AC8 preserves JSON fields, but constraints and acceptance criteria do not require prompts/status text to avoid stdout in --json mode.
